title: Calculator skills
examples: What is the best way to use the scientific functions on my calculator?
How do I make sure my calculator is set up correctly for different types of maths?
Can you show me a quick trick for using the statistics mode?

explain.say: Today we are learning to use your calculator better.
First we look at fractions on the calculator.
Next we practice using standard form for big numbers.
Then we explore finding the mode in statistics.
We must always check our calculations carefully.
In real life, you use calculators for recipes.

faq.q: How do I enter a fraction like three quarters?
faq.a: You can usually enter it as three divided by four. Some calculators have a dedicated fraction button.
asks: What is the fraction button for?

faq.q: What is standard form really used for?
faq.a: It is used to write very large or very small numbers simply. It uses powers of ten to keep things neat.
asks: Why do I need scientific notation?

faq.q: What does the mode tell me about a set of numbers?
faq.a: The mode is the number that appears most often in a group of data. It tells you the most common value.
asks: How do I find the most frequent number?
Is mode the same as average?

faq.q: Why is checking my work so important?
faq.a: Checking ensures you did not make a simple arithmetic error. It helps you find mistakes before you hand in your paper.
asks: What should I look for when checking?

faq.q: Can I use my phone calculator for these things?
faq.a: Phone calculators are fine for basic maths, but they might lack the specific scientific functions you need. Always check the instructions.
asks: What is the difference between phone and scientific?

facts: A fraction is a part of a whole, shown as a numerator over a denominator.
Standard form writes numbers as a coefficient times ten to a power.
The mode is the value that occurs with the greatest frequency in a data set.
Always check your units when solving a physics or chemistry problem.

quiz.say: What is three-quarters written in standard form?
quiz.why: You convert the fraction to a decimal value, which is zero point seven five.

wrong.1: This mistake happens when you simply put the numbers next to each other.
wrong.2: This is the original fraction, but the question asks for the decimal form.
wrong.3: This mistake happens when you incorrectly place the decimal point.

quiz.say: A number like 5,000,000,000 is best written as:
quiz.why: The number five billion is five multiplied by ten to the power of nine.

wrong.0: This is too large; you counted one too many places to the left.
wrong.2: This is incorrect because you missed counting one of the zeros in the number.
wrong.3: This mistake happens when you forget to adjust the coefficient when moving the decimal.

quiz.say: In the data set {12, 15, 12, 18, 15, 12}, what is the mode?
quiz.why: The number twelve appears three times, which is more than any other number.

wrong.0: This is adding the numbers instead of finding the most common one.
wrong.2: Fifteen appears twice, but twelve appears more often.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the mode must be a single most frequent number.
